description: A React component implementing a customizable dialog/modal for the Notesnook app, supporting input, notices, checkboxes, and buttons, with event subscriptions for opening and closing.

methods.name: onPressPositive
methods.description: Handles positive button press, executes positivePress callback if provided, manages loading state, and closes dialog.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the dialog with provided DialogInfo data if the context matches.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Closes the dialog and resets state, calls onClose callback if available.

methods.name: onNegativePress
methods.description: Handles negative button press, calls onClose callback if available, and hides the dialog.
